title: Feature budgeting — KPI triangle: headcount, pricing, latency (prototype)
content:
Sheet: Feature-level Budgeting & Headcount Sensitivity (Prototype)

Purpose:
- Quick experiment to map feature-level throughput (requests / month) to GPU-hours, equivalent FTE, and per-feature price sensitivity across regional GPU mixes and fractional staffing.
- Build a simple, repeatable template product + infra + people cost mapping so PMs can preview pricing impact when they change a feature's SLA or rollout region.

High-level assumptions (mutable):
- Avg tokens per request (prompt+response): 120 tokens
- Model mix: rfs-13b quantized (70%), rfs-7b (30%)
- GPU cost (billable): us-west A100-preemptible $3.10/hr, eu-central A100 on-demand $6.80/hr (list: proxy)
- Ops overhead per GPU-hour (monitoring, infra orchestration): $0.35/hr
- One equivalent FTE (SWE infra + SRE support) = 160 hours/week of capacity across features; model-serving overhead distributed by feature weight.
- Fractional FTE: we allow 0.1 increments (i.e., 10% of an FTE).
- Target margin for hosted route: 35% gross margin target (pre-S&M).

CSV Table: scenario-level summary (columns are explanatory)
Scenario,Monthly requests,Monthly tokens (M),GPU hours/mo (est),GPU+$ops/mo (USD),Equivalent FTE (approx),Per-1k-req Cost (USD),Suggested price /1k req (35% margin)
Baseline Feature A,1,200,000,144,360,1,568,480,0.5,6.20,9.54

Notes on table (how numbers derived):
- Monthly tokens (M) = monthly requests * avg tokens / 1e6.
- GPU hours estimated from perf profile: baseline mix = 120 tokens/request => ~0.00012 GPU-hr/request for quantized 13b with continuous batching; 7b variant ~0.00008 GPU-hr/request; composite estimated via weighted avg.
- GPU+$ops = (GPU-hr * regional unit cost) + ops overhead * GPU-hr.
- Equivalent FTE approximated by (support hours per month for feature) / (160 * 4.33). Support hours include monitoring alerts, rollout ops, CS onboarding time apportioned by feature. (placeholder: 20h/mo baseline).

Regional sensitivity quick grid (two axes): region vs. price per 1k req (baseline model mix)
region,us-west,eu-central,ap-southeast
unit gpu $/hr (proxy),3.10,6.80,4.50
per-1k cost (baseline),6.20,8.06,6.88
impact vs us-west,0%,+30%,+11%

Fractional headcount pump model (novel):
- Idea: rather than hiring full FTE for feature support at low volumes, use fractional capacity (contractor 0.2 FTE + shared SRE pool).
- Example: feature B projected 250k req/mo -> Equivalent FTE = 0.08. Hiring threshold for 0.25 FTE contract vs full FTE assumed at 0.5 FTE.
- Cost to company of fractional contractor (0.25 FTE) assumed 1.6x of prorated salary due to overhead and agency fees.

Headcount sensitivity run (small table):
Feature,Projected req/mo,Equivalent FTE (calc),Cost if hire 1 FT (ann),Cost if 0.25 contractor (ann),Delta (ann)
Feature B,250,000,0.08,140,000,56,000,84,000
Feature C (emerging),1,000,000,0.32,140,000,88,000,52,000

Pricing sensitivity micro-experiments (how to present to PMs):
- Input knobs: (1) Model mix (13b vs 7b), (2) Regional deployment (US vs EU), (3) Batching window (ms), (4) KV prefix cache hit rate (0–100%), (5) Fractional FTE allocation.
- Output: per-1k requests unit cost, suggested list price to hit margin, monthly cost delta vs baseline.
- Quick rule-of-thumb: 10% increase in cache hit rate -> ~7–12% reduction in GPU-hours for typical assistant prompts.

Open questions & TODOs (internal):
- [ ] Validate GPU-hr/request estimates with serving-runtime perf team (Samir owning). Link: JIRA:ENG-SERVE-991
- [ ] Replace proxy regional unit costs with actual committed Dedicated pricing (priority for Q4 renewals)
- [ ] Add CS onboarding time breakdown by enterprise vs self-serve (affects Equivalent FTE)
- [ ] Wire this sheet to product feature catalog so TRAFFIC numbers can be auto-populated (confluence:PROD/feature-catalog)

Actionable experiments (next 6 weeks):
1) Run live A/B: Route 20% of feature A traffic to a batching-optimized variant for 2 weeks. Measure GPU-hours and latency 95/99. (Owner: Daria)
2) Contractor trial: hire 0.25 FTE infra contractor for experimental features to test fractional model. Track real cost multiple. (Owner: Priya)
3) Regional trial: pilot EU on-demand vs US preemptible mix for non-P95 traffic window. (Owner: Noah)

Quick sensitivity visualization spec (for PM dashboard):
- X axis: monthly requests (log scale)
- Y axis: per-1k unit cost (USD)
- Lines: model mix variants (13b-q, 7b-q, hybrid), shaded bands for regional unit cost ranges
- Overlay: discrete markers where Equivalent FTE crosses 0.25, 0.5, 1.0 thresholds

Footnotes & provenance:
- This is a prototype sheet — intentionally conservative on ops overhead and conservative on cache benefits.
- Numbers are rounded for readability; detailed per-call simulation lives in the linked JIRA/Confluence artifacts.
- If adopted, this becomes the canonical PM-facing pricing preview template for feature scoping.

Notes to self (scan for quick edits):
- Keep latency-first vs cost-first rows orthogonal; double-check formula cells after perf team data arrives.
- Consider adding a second tab mapping price elasticity by customer segment (startups, midmarket, enterprise).

End of sheet.
